what: On hover the letters fade one by one from the front to .2 (.4s, .05s per letter, power1.out), then sharpen one by one again (.4s, .1s per letter, power1.in). The sharpening starts overlapping, letter count × .06s before the fade ends, so it passes like a wave. Hovering again before it finishes does not restart from the beginning. Marks in the same link (arrow icon, small photo) get is-hovered while hovered, a quiet hover that does not change color, like the thin serif menu of a temple or inn site

options.[data-fx-part=text]: (optional) text to blink — if absent, the whole text of the attached element. Used when only ‹View more› inside a large link blinks
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: (if present) a child that gets is-hovered while hovered — arrow graphic fades to .5 · small photo 1.1x (css on the user side)
options.lap: Overlap per letter (s) — sharpening starts earlier by letter count × lap, default .06
options.marks: If all, targets every [data-fx-part in the document, not just inside this link=mark] gets is-hovered added — in the original site, hovering any link makes all the “Learn more” arrows and the notice panel photo react together
